info.title: agents-control
info.description: The methods the control plane answers itself, with no `h`. Every method's params are its one `params` value, sent as JSON-RPC's whole params (an object, or for a few a bare value), as DaemonAPI sends them. A method with `x-notification` has no result: the server sends it. The `web` tag marks what the web page calls and hears (DaemonAPI.WebSignatures); a method a Go step ports joins with its types, schema first.

x-declared-capabilities.name: client.wire/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A client says its capabilities in ControlAuth on each connect, and reads -32008 as "update this app" (#1748). The control plane requires it of clients.

x-declared-capabilities.name: client.team/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A client knows it belongs to one person of a team (#994, #1763). On a control plane with more than one person, the control plane answers a client without it -32074 updateToJoinTeam (R14).

methods.name: attention/need
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (R6).

methods.name: attention/turn
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1744): a session's turn moved to a new phase.

methods.name: backups/stored
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1815): every backup of its owner's machines in the control plane's store, newest first.

methods.name: backups/upload
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1815): one part of a backup, in its own folder of the store.

methods.name: backups/commit
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1815): a backup's parts are all there; write its .json and keep the newest keep.

methods.name: backups/download
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1815): one part of a listed backup, for a restore.

methods.name: clients/announce
methods.description: On a pairing connection, before any other.

methods.name: clients/list
methods.description: devices/list, from a Remote of before the control plane, is answered the same; devices/startPairing as clients/startPairing, devices/forget with DeviceForget as clients/forget (daemon.openrpc.json has the host's own).

methods.name: clients/setGrant
methods.description: Retired with grants (#111): always refused, in words.

methods.name: clients/setPushToken
methods.description: A device, over its own session (#1460): its APNs token, kept in its own client record, which only it may set. Refused from a window or a browser.

methods.name: clients/setActivityToken
methods.description: A device, over its own session (#1744): the push token of one session's Live Activity, kept in its own client record, which only it may set. Refused from a window or a browser.

methods.name: control/ping
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0.

methods.name: control/rotate
methods.description: An admin rotates the control plane's key (#997, spec 736 FR-043). Every member's connection is closed; each connects again with the previous key and is given the new one in ok. The previous key is accepted for 30 days. Refused on a control plane of several copies, or one whose key is handed in (AGENTS_CONTROL_KEY, --key-fd).

methods.name: git/credential
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0, for its own git (#1122).

methods.name: handover/status
methods.description: On a copy's session (x:handover-…) only: what this copy says of itself (R16).

methods.name: host/hello
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0, on every connect.

methods.name: host/providerDraft
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0, for a writing agent there (#858).

methods.name: host/status
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#691 US4).

methods.name: host/workspaces
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0, for an agent there (#691 US6).

methods.name: hosts/announce
methods.description: On an enrolment connection, before any other.

methods.name: hosts/update
methods.description: Update a server's host over ssh (#1766): its server and key given again, the host key checked as at an install, the server's root checked to be this host's, then the control plane's agentsd, MCP servers and toolsets copied and the host started again. The answer is an install's: {needsTrust, name} first for a key not yet trusted, then {updated: true, name}.

methods.name: projects/detected
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#429): its answer to projects/detect.

methods.name: relay/switch
methods.description: A relay host, on its channel 0 (#824).

methods.name: tunnel/open
methods.description: The borrowing host, on its channel 0 (T091).

methods.name: workspaces/forAgent
methods.description: Through host/workspaces only.

methods.name: projects/detect
methods.description: To a host just added, from a control plane before #656.

methods.name: relay/count
methods.description: To a relay host, on its channel 0 (#1163).

methods.name: relay/deliver
methods.description: To a relay host, on its channel 0 (T097).

methods.name: host/clients
methods.description: To every host, on its channel 0, when it connects and when a window is paired or forgotten (#1118): the windows it may let in on its local socket.

methods.name: relay/devices
methods.description: To a relay host, on its channel 0 (T096).

methods.name: usage/rollup
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1811): its usage by the hour and the day.

methods.name: host/userSettings
methods.description: To a machine that says host.user-settings/1, on its channel 0, at join and on each change (#1760): its user's settings and secrets.
